This page explores the relationship between film budgets and worldwide revenues. @fig-budget-revenue shows each film as one point, with values in millions of US dollars.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Film budgets and worldwide revenues in millions of US dollars."

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (million US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
